svg.text: Emilia | ORIGINAL S4 garment / body interaction
Source artwork is not repainted. No synthetic anatomy or cloth appears in this evidence layer.
K = inferred close-follow. F = visible flare / projecting edge; an actual air gap is not measured.
E and V are observed image boundaries/surfaces. H marks concealment, not an anatomical outline.
The inner border follows the visible purple region
The near lower lip flares beyond exposed purple. No

The white outline is not the torso profile.

painted lines do not determine hidden depth.
Most anterior fullness is hidden. Cape above and behind
the panel is excluded from body evidence.
Near and far white regions are differently foreshortened; do not mirror this posed aperture.
Forward lean, arm pose, perspective and cloth motion confound a neutral true-side contour.
A narrow inner white/purple boundary is visible.
A small lower white lip projects in the image;
Visible hem segments cover purple. The large white arm
region is not a free chest outline.

The near-side angle compresses the opening into a partial strip; far edges are occluded.
Sitting and bracing alter posture. This is near-side artwork, not an orthographic body scan.
